jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Tax Compliance and Tax Controversy (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you ready to shape how Tax Compliance and Tax Controversy are managed at Boehringer Ingelheim?
Join our Global Tax Compliance & Tax Controversy team and make an impact. As the central tax partner for Boehringer Ingelheim's German entities, we ensure reliable tax filings and reporting and steer tax audits and disputes from strategy through resolution.
As Senior Manager Tax Compliance & Tax Controversy, you will combine tax expertise, risk management, and transformation. You will take ownership of complex matters, develop robust and pragmatic positions, and collaborate across Tax, Finance, Legal, and other functions.
You will also help shape the future of our tax function by using artificial intelligence, modern tax systems, and data-driven approaches to turn new ideas into practical improvements.
Tasks & responsibilities

- You will advise Boehringer Ingelheim's German entities on corporate income tax matters and international reporting obligations and collaborate with relevant internal functions.
- Furthermore, you will prepare and review corporate income tax returns, tax calculations, and reporting for annual financial statements.
- Managing German tax audits end-to-end, including requests, responses, data, technical input, and communicating with tax authorities and external advisors will be part of your main responsibilities.
- in Addition, you will develop consistent international controversy strategies, governance standards, and documentation, and monitor related tax risks and reserves.
- Using artificial intelligence and modern tax systems to improve process quality, efficiency, and scalability while ensuring sound judgment, data protection, and governance will enrich the position.
- With your experience, you will challenge existing ways of working and will drive smarter, more standardized, and increasingly automated processes.

Requirements

- Degree in Economics, Business Administration, Law, or a comparable field, ideally focused on taxation or accounting
- Several years of experience in German corporate income tax, tax compliance and reporting, and tax audits or disputes
- Sound knowledge of German tax procedural law and experience with tax authorities, appeals, or litigation
- Ability to assess complex tax matters, develop defensible positions, and coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisors
- Strong project management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
- Enthusiasm for artificial intelligence, digital tools, and tax systems, combined with curiosity and a drive to turn new solutions into reliable process improvements
- Strong communication and teamwork skills, sound judgment, analytical thinking, and a structured, independent working style
- Professional fluency in German and English

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. Lead the Future of Medicine - as (Senior) Clinical Program Lead in the Therapeutic Area of Pulmonology.
To ensure the fastest and most focused path from strategy to patients, we are evolving our OneHP organization. Together, we are simplifying our structures, strengthening the accountability of Therapeutic Areas, and creating clear interfaces between Innovation and Business. This ensures that our assets are efficiently transformed into successful brands, with the ultimate goal of delivering lasting value to patients around the world.

As (Senior) Clinical Program Lead, you will play a key role in advancing a Phase III program through submission activities, pediatric development strategy, and cross-functional clinical leadership.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.

- Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including development teams, key opinion leaders, steering committees, and safety monitoring boards.
- Contribute to scientific publications, evidence generation activities, and Medical Affairs deliverables to support the overall asset strategy.

- Supervise and mentor other Clinical Program Leads within the assigned program area.
- Represent the development team in governance and leadership committees and contribute to strategic portfolio decisions.

Requirements

- Several years of experience in clinical drug development within the pharmaceutical industry or equivalent experience in academic clinical research.
- Experience interacting with regulatory authorities and contributing to global regulatory submissions.
- Ability to evaluate and develop clinical development strategies, study concepts, and clinical trial designs.
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.

jobs.occupation: Laborant in der Qualitätskontrolle (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Methodenetablierung (Chemielaborant/in)
jobs.description:
Your role: Laboratory Assistant in Quality Control (m/f/d)

The position is initially limited to 2 years.

In this technically demanding role, you will be largely responsible for the practical implementation and maintenance of our analytical test procedures. Your focus will be on ensuring robust analysis in accordance with international standards directly in the laboratory.

Your Responsibilities:

- Wide-ranging analysis: You will apply chromatographic (HPLC, GC) and wet chemical methods to ensure precise quality control, maintaining data integrity through GMP-compliant documentation and modern laboratory standards (e.g., 5S).
- Pharmacopoeia compliance: You will independently establish and verify analytical methods according to applicable monographs (e.g. EP, USP) and carry out verifications in regulatory revisions.
- Method optimization & CAPA management: You will experimentally investigate and optimize analytical procedures in the context of deviations and CAPA measures to sustainably increase methodological robustness.
- Conducting validation studies: You will carry out method validations and verifications for new products and feedstocks practically on the device and strictly comply with GMP requirements.
- Securing method transfer (APVs): You will develop "best practices" for analytics and record them in supplementary audit regulations (APVs) to ensure consistent application of the methods across the team.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

- Education: You have completed training as a chemical laboratory assistant (m/f/d), CTA (m/f/d) or a comparable qualification and 2+ years relevant professional experience in pharmaceutical quality control.
- Expertise: You have in-depth, field-tested knowledge in instrumental analysis (HPLC, GC, spectroscopy) as well as in the application of international pharmacopoeia (EP, USP).
- Languages: Fluent German and good English skills for working with international pharmacopoeia.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Methodological competence: Experience in the practical processing of methodological issues in the context of CAPA processes and in the implementation of method validations.
- Way of working: High level of technical understanding of laboratory processes, work reliably in the implementation of complex monographs and passion for working directly in the laboratory.
- IT affinity: Experience with MS Office and chromatography data systems (e.g. Empower) and SAP.

What we offer you – Why Elanco?

- Attractive salary according to the chemical tariff (MTV), full 13th month salary (Christmas bonus) and 40 € holiday pay per day. Plus: employer-financed pension scheme**.**
- Work-life balance: 37.5-hour week and 30 days of vacation. On top of that, there's the "future amount" (up to 5 extra days off or cash), overtime? Are recorded and compensated for by free time**.**
- Well-being: Hansefit membership, annual events (our employee party is legendary!) and preventive care offers directly on site.
- Convenient commute: Subsidy for the job ticket and free parking.
- Benefits: Employee share purchase program and corporate benefits platform.

Additional Information:

- Location: Kiel, Germany - On-site Work Environment
- Travel: 0%
- Position: Limited contract of 2 years.

As Head of Forecasting, you are the single analytical authority for all sales and demand forecasts at IronMaxx. You define the logic, methodology, and quality of the forecast end-to-end. With you, the forecast stands or falls.
Demand Planning is part of your responsibility – derived from the forecast and deliberately kept lean and standardized. Your focus is not operational complexity, but forecast accuracy, transparency, and reliability as the foundation for all downstream decisions.
Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus Forecast Ownership & Analytical Excellence

• Definition, continuous improvement, and enforcement of forecast logic and methodology as a single source of truth.
• Acting as the final decision-making authority for all forecast-related questions and adjustments.

• Deep analysis of forecast accuracy, bias, and deviations with clear corrective actions.

Demand Planning – derived & simplified
• Conceptual responsibility for Demand Planning as a direct and consistent derivation of the forecast.
• Reduction of complexity through standardization, clear rules, and transparent assumptions.
• Ensuring demand figures are plausible, explainable, and actionable for Supply Chain and Operations.
• Close alignment with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Production to translate forecasts into executable plans.

Data, Tools & Governance
• Methodological ownership of forecasting models, KPIs, and planning tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline).
• Continuous improvement of data quality, transparency, and reproducibility.
• Development of scenarios, simulations, and what-if analyses to support management and financial decisions.
• Collaboration with Finance to align forecast, budget, and business cases.

Leadership & Cross-functional Alignment
• Functional and disciplinary leadership of the Planning & Ordering team with a strong analytical focus.
• Clear positioning of Sales, eCommerce, and Product Development as structured input providers, not forecast owners.
• Sparring partner for Management – fact-based, structured, and data-driven.
• Responsibility for relevant KPIs, performance monitoring, and reporting.

Your skillset - as strong as our protein
• Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Data Analytics, or a comparable field.
• Several years of experience in Forecasting / Sales Forecasting / Demand Forecasting (ideally FMCG: Food and E-Commerce).
• Proven ownership of forecast quality, logic, and methodology.
• Strong analytical mindset and ownership responsibility
• Excellent command of ERP and forecasting tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline) and advanced Excel skills.
• Leadership experience with a structured, clarity-driven management style.
• Very good English skills, German Skills are a plus

About us Quality & Innovations from IronMaxx® Nutrition
Premium sports nutrition - Designed in Germany!
Producing the best sports nutrition worldwide is the goal of IronMaxx®.

The production of highly efficient sports nutrition of the best quality and the constant further development of our products led to the award of the State Prize for Excellent Food Quality by the State of North Rhine-Westphalia. However, this is no reason for us to rest on our laurels - we are constantly working with the greatest passion to offer you supplements that inspire, work and taste great! The integration of the latest study results and the evaluation of practical field research in cooperation with professional sports clubs and our customers have led to permanent innovation in the development of new sports and fitness nutrition at IronMaxx® Nutrition since the company was founded in 2004.

In addition to the basics of sports nutrition in the areas of strength/endurance, muscle building and diet , this includes effective nutritional supplements for health and prevention , intelligent new combinations of active ingredients and improved dosage forms, such as our Tricaps® .

In the area of protein products, for example, IronMaxx® has set a milestone in the evolution of the latest sports nutrition products with the development of water-based protein powders in over 31 flavors. The sweet spread with the world's highest protein content , IronMaxx® Protein Creme, also comes from us.

Designed in Germany - as a German sports nutrition manufacturer, IronMaxx® is also committed to outstanding quality and seamless quality control.

High performance - the goal is the goal.

Well-known professional clubs, such as the eight-time German ice hockey champions, the "Kölner Haie", or the traditional handball club VfL Gummersbach with its unique success story, have relied for years on the efficient sports nutrition from IronMaxx® and on our expertise in the use and mode of action of nutritional supplements.

While in many areas of life the "path is often proclaimed as the goal", our customers usually have a very clear idea of their "dream body" and its desired performance. This passion to achieve their personal goa l is something we share with all our partners and customers - be it an athletic body, achieving new personal bests, reducing body weight or achieving sporting team success.

IronMaxx® products have therefore become an integral part of the product range of many European fitness studios, wholesalers, pharmacies and body stores in recent years due to their high quality.

You translate centrally defined forecasts into stable demand, inventory, and ordering decisions, lead your team with clarity and empathy, and act as a close sparring partner to the Head of Forecasting.
While the final ownership of the forecast lies with the Head of Forecasting, you ensure that forecasts work in reality — operationally sound, executable, and stable across the supply chain.
Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus Demand Planning Ownership
• End-to-end responsibility for operational and tactical demand planning, derived from the central forecast.
• Ensuring high product availability, stable inventory levels, and efficient replenishment.
• Creation, maintenance, and validation of demand, inventory, and ordering plans.
• Continuous monitoring of stock levels, safety stock, lead times, and sales performance.
• Early identification of risks such as shortages, overstocks, or supply bottlenecks.

Buying & Supplier Coordination
• Close operational collaboration with Purchasing and suppliers regarding orders, quantities, and delivery schedules.
• Tracking delivery dates, production status, and proactive escalation of delays or risks.
• Ensuring a smooth and reliable flow of goods across the supply chain.

Sparring & Cross-functional Collaboration
• Acting as a key sparring partner to the Head of Forecasting, providing operational feedback and plausibility checks on forecasts.
• Close alignment with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Production, and Procurement.
• Translating strategic forecast assumptions into executable operational actions.

Processes, Tools & Continuous Improvement
• Hands-on use and further development of demand planning and ERP tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline).
• Identification and implementation of operational improvements in demand planning, replenishment, and buying processes.
• Contribution to scenario analyses, data evaluations, and cross-functional process optimization projects.

Your skillset - as strong as our protein
• Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a comparable qualification.
• Several years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Purchasing, or related fields, ideally with leadership responsibility.
• Strong analytical and structured mindset with high numerical affinity.
• Proven experience in leading teams (disciplinary and/or functional).
• Strong people skills: clear, empathetic, reliable, and collaborative

The foundation Max-Planck-Institut für Kohlenforschung in Mülheim an der Ruhr is a renowned research institution that is over 100 years old and has already received two Nobel Prizes in its history. The institute is engaged in basic research in the field of catalysis with the aim of maximizing the efficient use of natural resources.

As a part of the Cluster of Excellence RESOLV (Ruhr Explores Solvation), the Early Career research group “Catalysis” of Dr. Hanna Hinrika Cramer develops organometallic catalysts with earth-abundant first-row transition metals. The team combines experiments, quantum chemistry, and spectroscopy to study reaction mechanisms and to discover how solvation and catalyst design affect the rate and selectivity. Current projects focus on developing well-defined chromium precatalysts for applications in olefin upgrading and the activation of strong bonds. 

The Cramer group invites applications for a

PhD Student in Organometallic Catalysis 

(full-time, with 39 hours)

Job description: 

- the synthesis and characterization of organometallic complexes
- the development of catalytic applications
- and quantum chemical calculations on electronic structures and reaction mechanisms

Qualifications:

- a Master’s degree in chemistry or a related field
- basic knowledge and research experience in molecular inorganic chemistry, coordination chemistry, catalysis, and/or reaction mechanisms
- excellent oral and written communication skills in English
- intrinsic motivation and curiosity about organometallic catalysis and sustainable chemistry

Job offer: The position is funded for three years and located at Ruhr University Bochum (RUB). Students will participate in the integrated Graduate School Solvation Science (iGSS) including a three-month international research stay, industrial internship, or entrepreneurship training. As part of RESOLV, the group has access to state-of-the-art infrastructure and collaborations with partners at RUB and at the Max Planck Institute für Kohlenforschung. Group members will therefore have the chance to learn highly diverse techniques, depending on their research focus and interest.

Applications: Please send your application package including a motivation letter, CV, and transcript of records to Dr. Hanna Hinrika Cramer (hanna.cramer@rub.de (https://mailto:hanna.cramer@rub.de) ) by October 23, 2026. Further information about the position can be requested by email.  Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. The earliest possible starting date is January 01, 2027, but the exact date is flexible.

The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Severely disabled applicants will be given priority if equally qualified. We ask for your understanding that submitted application documents will not be returned.

jobs.description:
Company

Through its Rothe Erde, Uhde and Polysius businesses as well as the majority investment thyssenkrupp nucera, Decarbon Technologies delivers innovative, cutting-edge technologies for the transition to a climate-neutral industrial economy. Rothe Erde is a leading provider of bearings and solutions that play a key role in wind, solar and tidal power plants, among other things. With its solutions for decarbonization, defossilization and the circular economy, Uhde is a technology and implementation provider of large-scale plants for the chemical industry. Polysius supplies green technologies for the cement and lime industry, digital automation solutions, and on-site and remote maintenance services. thyssenkrupp nucera is a global supplier of electrolysis technology for the industrial-scale production of clean hydrogen. The segment employs around 12,000 people, who generated revenues of approximately 3.8 billion euros in fiscal year 2023/2024.

Your responsibilities

- You will actively contribute to the further development and effective implementation of the Compliance Management System within the Decarbon Technologies segment and take ownership of selected compliance areas, including anti-corruption, data compliance, anti-money laundering, and export control/trade compliance. A key focus of your role will be the provision of antitrust and competition law advice as well as the further development and implementation of competition law compliance measures.
- You will help ensure that segment-wide standards are adhered to, compliance risks are identified at an early stage, and regulatory requirements are implemented efficiently across the organization.
- As part of a holistic compliance approach, you will advise and support the business on additional compliance topics, particularly with regard to the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) and related regulatory requirements.
- You will advise the companies within the thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies segment on a broad range of compliance matters. This includes, among other things, providing antitrust and competition law advice in MundA projects, addressing liability-related questions arising from the application of the Compliance Program, and supporting the coordination and enablement of Compliance Officers in the Business Units and regions. In doing so, you will contribute to the effective and consistent implementation of compliance requirements throughout the segment.
- You will support compliance reporting at segment and Group level, assist in the development of compliance processes, policies, concepts, and preventive measures, and accompany their implementation in an international environment.
- You will monitor and analyze regulatory developments and compliance risks, derive appropriate measures, and support their implementation.
- In addition, you will independently manage cross-functional compliance projects and actively drive the further development of the compliance organization and compliance culture within the segment.

Your profile

- You are passionate about working collaboratively and excited to contribute to the further evolution of Compliance at thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies during a period of transformation and growth.
- You hold an degree in Law and have successfully completed the Second German State Examination (Second State Exam) or possess an equivalent legal qualification. Additional qualifications, such as an LL.M. or other postgraduate degree, are considered an asset.
- You bring significant and recent experience in a senior compliance role within an international corporation or complex business environment. You have a proven track record of not only advising on compliance matters, but also shaping, implementing, and continuously improving compliance programs and governance frameworks.
- You have extensive expertise in the design, implementation, and enhancement of Compliance Management Systems (CMS).
- You have substantial experience advising on competition and antitrust law matters in an international business context, including cooperation agreements, distribution structures, public tenders, and MundA transactions.
- Your expertise covers key compliance areas, including competition law, anti-corruption, data protection and digital regulation, anti-money laundering, and trade compliance.
- You combine strong legal and regulatory knowledge with a pragmatic, business-oriented approach and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical solutions.
- You are an effective communicator with strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and credibility across all levels of the organization.
- You thrive in an international and cross-cultural environment and distinguish yourself through integrity, discretion, resilience, and a high level of personal accountability.
- You have successfully led complex, cross-functional, and international projects and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
- You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. German and Spanisch language skills are highly desirable.

Your benefits

At thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies, we are committed to providing an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally. Our benefits include:

- The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by contributing to the continued growth and success of thyssenkrupp Decarbon Technologies in a dynamic and future-oriented industry.
- A competitive compensation package combined with attractive benefits.
- Flexible working hours, hybrid and mobile working arrangements, and the opportunity, subject to agreement, to work remotely from within the European Union for up to 20 days per year.
- A wide range of health and wellbeing initiatives, including confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services, preventive healthcare offerings through our occupational health service (such as health screenings and seasonal vaccinations), and various sports and wellness programs.
- Extensive professional and personal development opportunities through a broad portfolio of training programs, learning initiatives, and career opportunities across the thyssenkrupp Group.
- A structured and personalized onboarding program designed to help you settle in quickly and build a strong network from day one.

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.
